done_when: A queued CI failure is not delivered while the same workflow and commit has a newer run on GitHub, even inside the checks cache window, and a test covers a rerun that starts within the cache window

known.title: Queued CI failures are lost if the pane session restarts during the freshness wait

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Line 109 holds a queued failure until a later checks fetch. If the turn ends during the cache window and the user restarts the pane before that fetch, session cleanup clears `pending` (events.ts:145), and the new session's baseline marks the still-visible workflow ID as seen (events.ts:71–75). The unchanged failure is then never delivered, even after fresh checks arrive. The new test covers waiting in one session but not this normal restart path.
findings.title: Queued CI failures are lost if the pane session restarts during the freshness wait

why: The pane can still deliver a queued CI failure when its rerun starts within the board's one-minute checks cache, because the cached snapshot does not show the rerun yet
